    Type D traces in every characteristic (Appendix B) #

    characteristic-two-mesh-calculations.tex: "In word degree j < N the alternating words w_j, w'_j, starting with x, y, span; in degree N they satisfy w_N + w'_N = 0. Multiplying this relation by x and y shows that both alternating words of degree N + 1 are zero. … In the ordinary trace, the one-letter classes vanish …. An odd alternating word of length at least three rotates to a word containing a square. For even j, rotation identifies w_j and w'_j. … If ι interchanges the two short arms, twisted rotation turns an even alternating word into a word containing a square, while in odd degree the two alternating words become equal."

    We record this without assumptions on the characteristic: every positive trace is an integer multiple of the trace of the alternating word altE starting with x; that trace vanishes in odd degree for the trivial twist, in even degree for the interchange, and in degree above N = L c + 2, where c is the long arm.
